content_of_post_to_comment:
(16m, idk if that matters)

at night i feel extremely motivated to be productive, do things, quit addictions, etc the next day, and i always feel excited for the next day to come so i can do these things, but when the next day comes i just feel like a loser chud again, just fall back into addiction and feel unmotivated basically as if that past motivation never existed. i’ll realize and be able to like notice “why am i doing this” or “why am i just sitting here doing nothing when i could study for my permit” but then i genuinely just don’t follow up on that.

i feel like one main cause to me being so lazy and unmotivated all day is because i had a hip disease (avn) that made it incredibly painful and stiff to walk for over a year, causing me to just kinda sit around and be lazy most days since their really wasn’t much i could do. i ended up getting my hip replaced over a month ago and im able to walk and feel good as new, but my habits from when i was less mobile just don’t leave

this post kinda became less about carrying the motivation over and just about needing some motivation overall, but any advice would be great please and thank you
comment: The hip situation actually makes a lot of sense. If you spent a year training your brain that most days were about sitting around and getting through pain, it’s probably not going to instantly switch back after surgery. I’d focus less on finding that nighttime motivation and more on proving to yourself with tiny daily actions that you’re someone who moves again.
